verdict.rationale: Cerebras is an inference API; the only related capability is the Batch API, which lets requests be processed asynchronously without immediate results, giving a thin form of background processing. There is no evidence of scheduling, triggers, persistent agent orchestration, or any dedicated 'automation' framework that would let a user set up autonomous background workflows. missing for 10: scheduling/trigger mechanisms, persistent agent/workflow orchestration, autonomous multi-step background execution beyond simple async batch requests.
